units.source_text: 但闻有一个女子答道：“怪哉！

en.t: Then he heard a woman answer, "How strange!

units.source_text: 来了一个奇妙的高丽人！”可知这个人是不知底细的。

en.t: A curious Korean has come!" From this, it was clear that this person knew nothing of the situation.

units.source_text: 帷屏后面另有一女子，默默不答，只是连声叹息。

en.t: Behind the curtain screen there was another woman, who remained silent and gave no answer, only sighing again and again.

units.source_text: 源氏公子便挨近这个人去，隔着帷屏握住了她的手，吟道：

en.t: Prince Genji drew close to her, took her hand through the curtain screen, and recited:
